title: Template
description: Definition of a reusable message/payload template with mustache-style placeholders, referenced by its file path from a step (or inlined directly in place of that path).

name.description: Optional human-readable display label for this template, shown in results/UI.

description.description: Optional free-text description of what this template represents.

clients.description: Names of the registered clients this template is valid for. A step must pair this template with one of these clients.

payload.description: The message/payload content itself, with mustache-style placeholders filled in from the step's 'data' at render time. Shape is free-form: an object for structured payloads (JSON, gRPC message maps, ...), or a string for raw/text payloads.

options.description: Client configuration for sending the payload with mustache-style placeholders filled in from the step's 'data' at render time, same as payload. Shape is defined by the client itself, not by this schema.

examples.name: create_order_request
examples.description: HTTP request to create an order.

examples.name: heartbeat_frame_v1
examples.description: Raw TCP heartbeat frame: pipe-delimited fields terminated with CRLF.
